acceptance_results.criterion: npm run check exits 0 on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0 with skipped 0 and todo 0, and the declaration count reconciles with the executed count.
node scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs . exits 0 on the repository as it stands, and the suite asserts the same thing so a future commit that makes the tree trip its own scanner fails CI.
Every row of the decoy table in test-kits/secret-scan.test.mjs is detected, and by the specific rule the row names, so a row cannot be kept green by an unrelated pattern widening.
No row of the false-positive table fires. The table includes shapes taken verbatim from this repository's committed prose and evidence.
An unreadable file, an unlistable directory, an undecodable file, an oversize file, and a symbolic link each produce a finding rather than a pass, and each is regression-tested.

The email-address rule is exempt only under evidence/ and handoffs/; the Thai national ID and Thai phone rules have no exemption anywhere; a credential inside evidence prose is still reported. All four properties are regression-tested.
node scripts/validate-work-package-ownership.mjs work-packages exits 0, proving the transfer leaves no path co-owned and every declared output covered by its own package's writable paths.

The WP-0A-A0-001 amendment is limited to removing the two transferred paths and adding an ownership.amended_by block; no status, role, gate, acceptance criterion, or delivered output of that package changes.
No file in the repository contains a literal credential-shaped string. Every decoy in the suite is assembled from fragments at runtime, because the suite is itself inside the tree the scanner walks.
The Author does not review, security-review, test-verify, or integrate this package.

tests.result: see evidence/VERIFICATION.md, which is machine-written and compared byte-for-byte against a live run

security_privacy_cost_impact: data classification synthetic-only; secrets required false; network policy deny-unless-declared. No provider call, credential, migration or customer-data effect. Cost impact none: no metered resource is touched.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No schema, migration, provider call, credential or customer-data effect; Gate G0 forbids all of them and this package changed none.
compatibility_impact: No contract-catalog file is changed by this package, so no consumer contract is affected.
known_limitations: A fresh UNCORRELATED probe -- families the reviewer had not named in the previous round -- detected 8 of 56, and 3 of those 8 are not real coverage (one coincidental prefix hit, five re-detections of existing prefixes in a different file format). Against the 12 families it HAD named, 12 of 12. The improvement is real but NARROW: it fixed exactly what was named and did not generalize. Each round of this measurement fixes the round before it and misses the next.

The coverage guard cannot constrain a check script that never invokes it. Independent testing replaced every `&&` with `||`: step 1 succeeded, the chain short-circuited, and npm run check exited 0 having run neither the guard nor a single test. Requiring the guard to be the first step (exit 81) catches demotion but not non-invocation, and a trailing `&` is the same class. The remedy is for ci.yml to run the guard as its own workflow step; that file is owned by WP-0A-A0-001 and is read-only here, so it is referred to the Integration Owner under the RFC path. Recorded rather than claimed closed: this Author has twice declared a class closed and been falsified.

C1a: independent security review with an UNCORRELATED 56-decoy corpus measured 19 detected / 37 missed, against 12/12 and 17/17 from correlated samples. The Meta and Stripe misses are fixed because they are this project's own G0 blockers, but most cloud-vendor families and most credential-carrying file formats are still undetected. C1 is closed only as scoped: its fail-open and no-privacy-dimension components are closed; its near-zero-detection component is downgraded, not closed.

A Thai juristic-person tax ID shares the identical 13-digit mod-11 form as a national ID and is reported as one; roughly 9.45% of arbitrary 13-digit runs will fire. node_modules/ and .git/ are skipped entirely, so a vendored node_modules is invisible. Git history remains unscanned.

RFC-2026-005 is Proposed and requires Product Owner disposition before the RFC-2026-002 manual merge. Until approved it does not hold rank-1 authority, so the ownership transfer and the cross-package amendments are staged, not authorized.

A PATTERN SCANNER CANNOT PROVE THE ABSENCE OF SECRETS. It proves only that the declared patterns did not match the declared files at this commit. A credential in an unenumerated format, split across lines, encoded, or embedded in opaque bytes passes. This is a property of the approach and cannot be closed by widening the rule set; evidence citing a clean scan must not claim more than this. Measured: the strengthened scanner detects 13 of 14 realistic decoys, against 1 of 14 before.

Git history is still not scanned. The scanner walks the working tree and skips .git, so a credential committed and later deleted is invisible to it. Closing this needs a history-scanning pass and a decision about what to do when one is found, since history cannot be rewritten under RFC-2026-002's no-force-push rule.

The email-address rule is exempt under evidence/ and handoffs/. A customer email address pasted into an evidence file will not be caught. The scanner does not attempt to tell a maintainer address from a customer address, because any such test would be a domain allowlist masquerading as a security control.

Lowercase and JSON-style secret assignments such as api_key: "..." are not matched, because this repository's own contract-gap evidence contains that exact shape as prose. Detecting it would mean firing on the audit trail that documents the gaps.

Private and internal hostnames and RFC1918 addresses are not detected. This is the one decoy family still missed and it is declined deliberately: a .internal/.local/.corp rule fires on the committed taxonomy identifier topic.wardrobe.internal-function in docs/sprint-0a/sprint-0a-industry-research-pack-th.md.

Rule prefixes and length floors are calibrated to vendor formats as published at the time of writing. A vendor that silently changes a prefix or length defeats the corresponding rule and nothing in this repository would notice.

The scanner and its test are digested in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json, which RFC-2026-003 records as a TRIPWIRE WITH NO SELF-ANCHOR: a commit that edits a guarded file and its digest together passes. This package inherits that property and does not improve it.

The ownership transfer amends WP-0A-A0-001, whose Integration Owner /root/r0_steward is an OpenAI Codex run that was not available in this session. That manifest records acknowledgement_status: pending and the amendment is not complete until countersigned.
prefer_cross_vendor_review is not satisfied; see independence.cross_vendor_exception. Recorded as an exception, not waived.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.
No cardholder-data rule exists, though payment providers are among the named G0 blockers. Raised as an advisory by independent security review and not addressed here.

reviewer_instructions: Read evidence/WP-0A-A0-003/ first: it records what was verified, what was refused and why, and the independent findings that corrected this package.

Ten independent verification runs were dispatched against this stack. The first eight each shipped an untested business rule past every guard; the ninth and tenth could not, after roughly 22,000 and 9,350 mutations respectively, but each still found real defects elsewhere. Assume an eleventh exists.
Attack the guards rather than reading them. Every defect found so far came from execution and none from reading.
